final_prompt_en: A photograph of an adult cellist checking a cello bow before an outdoor performance on a small wooden stage beside the sea. The cellist is seated on a plain chair, with both feet set apart on the deck. The cello rests upright between their knees, its endpin planted in a rubber stop. They hold the bow horizontally at waist height in front of the cello. Their right thumb and forefinger pause at the frog's adjustment screw while the left hand supports the wooden stick near its balance point; their gaze follows the narrow, evenly stretched ribbon of hair beneath the stick. The sea breeze lifts loose hair at their temple and pulls a dark shirt cuff away from the wrist, while their shoulders stay settled and their mouth is softly set in concentration. Two waiting chairs and a music stand with clipped sheet music sit farther along the stage, making this small preparation feel close to the first note. Soft coastal daylight grazes the cheek and open collar, with a gentle glint along the bow hair and warm amber reflections in the cello. Compose a quiet environmental portrait that keeps the seated figure, both hands, the entire bow, and the instrument's point of support readable, with the pale water receding behind them. The fine, steady line of the bow carries attention against the moving hair and cloth.
